descriptionChirho: A cooked dish of boiled food, stew or pottage, associated with the Esau/Jacob narrative (Gen 25) and Elisha's pot (2 Kgs 4). S116927 simply adds the conjunction waw ('and-stew-of'), which is grammatical, not semantic. Multilingual evidence is consistent: eng 'stew/stew', spa 'guiso/guiso', hin 'पकवान/पकवान', arb 'طَبِيخًا/وَطَبِيخَ', kor '죽/죽', swa 'mchuzi/mchuzi'. All translations confirm a single culinary sense.
